record_type: Product-image reuse-rights investigation, assigned subset B
scope: Twelve existing published product families: six SKINN by Titan 20 ml EDP variants and six Vega beard trimmer models. Catalog content/products.json identities preserved.
method: Official product pages, official terms, Titan official press kit, official media/catalogue leads, public Wikimedia Commons searches. No pictures downloaded, hotlinked or republished; no permission requests, sign-in, paid services or purchases.

sources.observation: Titan identifies website images as its copyright material. Personal non-commercial downloads do not permit republication on Glowwise; written consent is required for publication. No such consent is held.

VEGA reserves image/material rights, allows personal non-commercial use, and restricts copying, republishing, uploading, posting, transmission and distribution absent prior written consent. No Glowwise consent is held.

Available press kit describes management portraits and logos for media consumption. The SKINN entry is a logo, not any catalog perfume/20 ml variant photograph. No product-photo licence found; a press contact is not permission.

Official PDF search result expressly marks product images and catalogue content copyright protected. Direct PDF open failed with Internal Error; no complete PDF inspection claimed, and no permissive image licence established.

queries: site:commons.wikimedia.org "Skinn by Titan" OR "Skinn Raw" OR "Skinn Steele" OR "Skinn Verge"
site:commons.wikimedia.org "VHTH-38" OR "VHTH-25" OR "VHTH-36" OR "VHTH-40" OR "VHTH-31" OR "VHTH-41"
sources.observation: No accurately matched licensed product photograph found in these searches. Results for VEGA microprocessors and Swedish leather terms are unrelated and rejected. This is a scoped search, not proof that no licensed picture exists anywhere.
Lead returned sign-in screen. Exact company identity, matching SKINN product assets and rights could not be established without account access; no account created or imagery used.
